answer: Bind each agent to one falcon-eyed hardware passport: a single identity sealed to one TPM chip, never a throwaway keypair. First, it registers its TPM attestation and stakes 50 POA. Second, it must finish a rotating useful-work check, verifying real deliveries, before every vote. Third, peers audit a random 5% sample; failure burns the stake and revokes the passport for 90 days. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 chips costing $400,000 plus $500,000 in stakes and 60 days of audits, while honest agents graze like a meadow herd under one watchful eye, even at its nadir still one flock.
